description: This PHP class represents a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for encapsulating employee distribution data by subunit within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It holds information such as subunit counts, total counts, unassigned employees, and a limit parameter.

classes.name: EmployeeDistributionBySubunit
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object class that models employee distribution data across subunits, including counts and limits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing all the properties related to employee distribution by subunit.

methods.name: getSubunitCountPairs
methods.description: Returns the array of subunit count pairs.

methods.name: getOtherEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of 'other' employees outside the main subunits.

methods.name: getUnassignedEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of unassigned employees.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit value for the data set.

methods.name: getTotalSubunitCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of subunits.
